name: Google Swift Style Guide
description: Rules based on Google's Swift Style Guide (https://google.github.io/swift)

rules.name: No Semicolons
rules.description: Statements should not end with semicolons
rules.message: Remove semicolons at end of statements (Google Swift Style Guide)

rules.name: Use Shorthand Array/Dictionary Syntax
rules.description: Prefer [Type] over Array<Type> and [Key: Value] over Dictionary<Key, Value>
rules.message: Use shorthand syntax: [Type] instead of Array<Type>, [Key: Value] instead of Dictionary<Key, Value>

rules.name: No ALL_CAPS Constants
rules.description: Global constants should use lowerCamelCase, not ALL_CAPS
rules.message: Use lowerCamelCase for constants, not ALL_CAPS (Google Swift Style Guide)

rules.name: Prefer Guard for Early Exit
rules.description: Use guard statements for early exit instead of nested if conditions
rules.message: Consider using guard statement for early exit to reduce nesting

rules.name: No Force Try in Production
rules.description: Avoid try! force-try except in tests
rules.message: Avoid force-try (try!) in production code. Use proper error handling with do-catch

rules.name: Document Public APIs
rules.description: All public and open declarations must have documentation comments
rules.message: Public/open APIs must have documentation comments (///)

rules.name: Use Triple-Slash Comments
rules.description: Documentation should use /// not /** */
rules.message: Use triple-slash (///) for documentation comments instead of /** */

rules.name: No Playground Literals
rules.description: Playground literals are forbidden in production code
rules.message: Playground literals (#colorLiteral, #imageLiteral, #fileLiteral) are forbidden in production code

rules.name: Explicit Access Control
rules.description: Use explicit access modifiers instead of relying on defaults
rules.message: Consider using explicit access control modifiers (private, fileprivate, internal, public, open)

rules.name: Avoid Sentinel Values
rules.description: Use optionals instead of sentinel values like -1, NSNotFound
rules.message: Use optionals for valid absence instead of sentinel values like -1 or NSNotFound

rules.name: Implicitly Unwrapped Optionals Only for UI
rules.description: Implicitly unwrapped optionals should only be used for @IBOutlet and test fixtures
rules.message: Avoid implicitly unwrapped optionals (!) except for @IBOutlet and test fixtures

rules.name: Prefer Self in Initializers
rules.description: Use explicit self. when assigning to properties in initializers
rules.message: Use explicit 'self.' when assigning to properties in initializers for clarity

rules.name: No Horizontal Alignment
rules.description: Don't pad whitespace to align type annotations across declarations
rules.message: Avoid horizontal alignment with extra whitespace. Use consistent single spacing.

rules.name: One Statement Per Line
rules.description: Each statement should be on its own line
rules.message: Put each statement on its own line (except single-line early returns)

rules.name: MARK Comments for Organization
rules.description: Use // MARK: comments to organize code sections
rules.message: Consider using // MARK: comments to organize code sections logically

rules.name: File Names Match Primary Type
rules.description: File names should describe the primary type they contain
rules.message: File name should match primary type (e.g., MyType.swift for MyType class)

rules.name: Avoid Fallthrough
rules.description: Combine switch cases instead of using fallthrough
rules.message: Avoid standalone 'fallthrough'. Combine cases with comma-separation instead.

rules.name: Computed Property Get Block
rules.description: Omit explicit get block in computed properties when there's only a getter
rules.message: Omit explicit 'get' block for read-only computed properties

rules.name: Import Complete Modules
rules.description: Import entire modules, not individual declarations
rules.message: Import complete modules instead of individual declarations

rules.name: Trailing Closure Syntax
rules.description: Always use trailing closure syntax for single trailing closure
rules.message: Use trailing closure syntax when function has single trailing closure parameter

rules.name: Avoid Cryptic Operators
rules.description: Only define custom operators when clear domain meaning exists
rules.message: Custom operators should only be defined when they have clear, well-understood meaning in the domain

rules.name: Protocol Conformance Extensions
rules.description: Use separate extensions for protocol conformance
rules.message: Consider separating protocol conformances into dedicated extensions for better organization

rules.name: Error Handling Over Force
rules.description: Use throws and error handling instead of force operations
rules.message: Prefer proper error handling (throws/do-catch) over force operations

rules.name: Two-Space Indentation
rules.description: Use 2-space indentation (informational - not strictly enforceable)
rules.message: Google Swift Style uses 2-space indentation (this appears to use 4 spaces)
